findings.title: agent → PMP JSON contract broken; pipeline cannot file issues or dedupe
findings.recommended_fix: Adopt the canonical last-findings.json contract from AGENTS.md §"Finding format" and route the issue-filing pipeline through it. Every agent now writes BOTH agents/<agent>/last-findings.json (machine) AND agents/<agent>/last-report.md (human). create-issues-from-findings.sh prefers the canonical JSON, falls back to the first ```json fenced block in last-report.md, validates with agents/scripts/validate-findings-json.js, and never crashes the whole run on a single bad input.
findings.reproducibility_notes: Before this fix: the technical-pmp pipeline logged '[create-issues] <agent>: malformed JSON, skipping' for every agent because last-report.md files were narrative markdown. After this fix: `bash agents/scripts/create-issues-from-findings.sh --dry-run` cleanly walks each agent, prefers last-findings.json, and validates before parsing.
